clean_description: In the twenty-second century, astronauts can transform their bodies through a process called somaforming, allowing them to survive in hostile environments on distant exoplanets. Ariadne, one of these explorers, chronicles her journey as she ecologically surveys four habitable worlds while grappling with the changes back on Earth. As she and her crewmates adapt physically and mentally, they confront the challenges of returning to a world that may have forgotten them.
setting: distant exoplanets and a transformed Earth
